reviews.content: It is PEAK. Allows customizing most of the ui elements in taskbar.

Immaculate by design and application. Thank you to Michael (m417z) for the insane possibilities with this mod, and thank you for the incessant and incredibly creative WH community for some scrumptious themes (my current setup is a frankenstein of chunks of like 4-5 different themes, custom styles, and snippets from the discord server. Still runs flawlessly, which is wondrous).
### TL;DR: Good stuff
